notes: Do not call paid image APIs in the Python pipeline.
Use fresh article-specific JPG assets generated by Codex built-in image generation.
Do not use SVG, reusable library, or general fallback images for public posts.
Do not generate fake Windows UI, readable error screens, logos, or text overlays.
Hero and inline images must have different roles and compositions.
Publishing stops if either required image is missing, generic, repeated, off-topic, text-heavy, or too similar to the other image.

prompt_policy.api_cost_policy: Do not call OpenAI Images API or external paid image APIs.
prompt_policy.prompt_method: Write a fresh one-off prompt for the exact article, reader problem, image role, and recent visual history before each built-in image generation call.
prompt_policy.diversity_rule: Avoid laptop-on-desk, coffee, generic office, and router scenes. Hero and inline images must use different medium, camera angle, dominant objects, and visual logic.
prompt_policy.quality_loop: Discard and regenerate any generic, repetitive, text-heavy, off-topic, or internally similar result before publishing.
